title: Lime Leaf Braised Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish made by slow-cooking chicken in a mixture of lime juice, herbs, and spices.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the lime juice, lime leaves, and fish sauce (if using) to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Reduce heat to low and braise the chicken for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with additional lime leaves and lime wedges (if desired).
